subject.title: feat(onboard): guided onboarding becomes the custodian flow

question: Should plain local guided onboarding permanently auto-apply setup and hatch the agent while persisting `wizard.accessMode`, rather than handing off to the system-agent chat?
rationale: This changes a public setup workflow, adds persistent configuration, and can trigger service-affecting setup operations; tests can verify implementation but cannot choose the permanent onboarding contract.

options.title: Sponsor after targeted repairs
options.body: Approve the custodian direction after preserving setup-repair chat, retaining configured routes in guarded mode, and rerunning fresh/configured live proof.

options.title: Narrow this phase
options.body: Land consent and quieter discovery only, leaving automatic apply and hatch for the later browser/bootstrap phase.

options.title: Retain conversational handoff
options.body: Keep system-agent chat as the default after inference and use hatch only behind an explicitly selected onboarding path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after targeted repairs
recommendation.body: Approve the custodian direction after preserving setup-repair chat, retaining configured routes in guarded mode, and rerunning fresh/configured live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The redesign document, implementation, and surrounding onboarding documentation make this person the strongest available owner for the permanent flow decision.
